2609.03721.title: Can LLMs Extract Architectural Design Decisions from Source Code Commits? - A Preliminary Exploratory Study
2609.03721.paper_summary: Context: Architectural Design Decisions (ADDs) capture the rationale behind the structure and evolution of software systems but are rarely documented explicitly, and are often hidden inside source code commits. Recovering them is important for Architectural Knowledge Management (AKM). Problem: Extracting ADDs from commits is challenging due to their implicit and unstructured nature. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in understanding code and text, yet their effectiveness for this task remains underexplored. Study: We present a preliminary study using four LLMs (Gemini 3 Pro, DeepSeek R1, Kimi K2, Qwen3) with zeroshot and fewshot prompting on 30 developer-written ADDs from open-source projects. We score outputs with ROUGE-L, BLEU, METEOR, and BERTScore, and one author manually reviews the Gemini outputs. Results: All models reach a BERT-F1 above 0.81, and fewshot prompting improves alignment (Gemini BERT-F1: 0.828 to 0.847). However, the generated ADDs are often too long, implementation-focused, and miss the rationale behind the decision. This highlights opportunities for architecture-aware LLM systems and automated AKM.
2609.03721.paper_summary_zh: 背景：架構設計決策（ADDs）捕捉了軟體系統結構和演變背後的理由，但通常未被明確記錄，並且經常隱藏在源代碼提交中。恢復這些決策對於架構知識管理（AKM）至關重要。問題：由於其隱含和非結構化的特性，從提交中提取ADDs是具有挑戰性的。大型語言模型（LLMs）在理解代碼和文本方面顯示出強大的能力，但它們在此任務上的有效性仍未被充分探索。研究：我們展示了一項初步研究，使用四個LLMs（Gemini 3 Pro、DeepSeek R1、Kimi K2、Qwen3）對來自開源項目的30個開發者撰寫的ADDs進行零樣本和少樣本提示。我們使用ROUGE-L、BLEU、METEOR和BERTScore對輸出進行評分，並由一位作者手動審查Gemini的輸出。結果：所有模型的BERT-F1均超過0.81，少樣本提示改善了對齊（Gemini BERT-F1：從0.828提高到0.847）。然而，生成的ADDs通常過長，過於專注於實現，並且缺乏決策背後的理由。這突顯了架構感知LLM系統和自動化AKM的機會。
